rationale: Implement the guarded factory test mode, field lockout, and bounded command protocol.
requested_changes: Entry: gpio_strap; A fixture-held strap on FTM_STRAP is sampled only during reset.; conditions: FTM_STRAP asserted by the keyed fixture before reset.; UART magic token PRODENG-FTM-v1 received before the 2-second boot timeout..
Field lockout: nvm_flag; Provisioning sets a write-once production-complete NVM flag that disables factory entry..
Interface: uart; 115200 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit; UTF-8 newline-delimited frames.; nets: FTM_STRAP, UART_RX, UART_TX.
TC-01: TEST SENSORS -> SENSORS PASS (timeout 2000 ms)
Provision serial_number from MES-issued unit serial; write_once=true.
Provision calibration from Factory calibration fixture; write_once=true.
Exit: Issue EXIT, restore the strap, and power-cycle; confirm normal firmware boot..
Total command timeout budget: 3.5 s; maximum: 6 s.
